name: review-pbi-diff
description: Turn a Power BI (PBIP) git diff into a manager-ready review artifact — a deterministic extractor builds a structured change model from hash-named visual.json and TMDL files, then the agent draws to-scale page wireframes, spec-checks every added/modified measure's DAX against the repo's metric definitions, and runs eleven evidence-backed red-flag checks (dangling measure references, ripple effects, hidden filters, visible scratch pages).
